'''2021 Fifth Annual GEMPC''' (Batmouse's 5th GEMPC) was the Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP, January–25 March 2021. [[Chris Hull]] defeated [[Timo Dusel]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc-gempc5">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/jokerking-wins-batmouses-5th-gempc/ Jokerking wins Batmouse's 5th GEMPC], starwarsccg.org (26 March 2021). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/jokerking-wins-batmouses-5th-gempc.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' January–25 March 2021
* '''Organizer:''' [[Anthony Howard]]
* '''Participants:''' 72 (8-player play-in)
